thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: SERVICE=redwood-inference-canary severity=high — 5xx rate spike on canary rollout (traffic=10%). Trigger: latency_threshold (p50>900ms)

pagerduty: Pager triggered: PD-INC-48291 — escalation to on-call

sara (oncall): acked. looking. can someone paste recent canary deploy id?

mike (infra): saw the alert in infra dash. canary deploy id = canary-v2026-07-22-3f5. logs show model_load errors from runtime nodes in us-west-2: "KV cache OOM while allocating 128MB"

jen (runtime): confirming. repro on canary instances: backend returning 500s for long prompts when kv cache hits >90%. pattern started at 14:02 UTC after the rollout step that bumped batch_size to 64.

kevin (releases): that's the step I changed in rollout policy to improve throughput. rolling back that change now unless someone objects.

sara (oncall): customer impact: ~3% of production requests routed to canary; backend 5xxs ~60% for those paths. no broad outage but noticeable for affected customers (retries show user-level errors). mark SEV2.

carol (sre): agreed SEV2. prioritize rollback and routing isolation. suggest immediate traffic-shift to stable and pause canary.

mike (infra): rerouting traffic: changing router policy to pin all prod traffic to stable instances. doing incremental change.

mike (infra): /deployctl set-traffic --service=inference-api --to=stable --percent=100 — running (should be <30s)

deploy-bot: action started: set-traffic for inference-api -> stable (100%). job id: jb-7821.

deploy-bot: action succeeded: set-traffic job jb-7821 completed in 12s.

jen (runtime): canary instances still returning 500s on their internal healthcheck. looks like the batch_size bump exposed a memory regression in kv cache sizing.

kevin (releases): issuing rollback command for canary change: `redwoodctl rollback --deployment canary-v2026-07-22-3f5 --to=canary-v2026-07-22-1a2`

mike (infra): running rollback. rolling back config and restarting canary pods one-by-one to avoid cascade.

deploy-bot: rollback job rb-991 queued, performing rolling restart of 3 canary nodes.

jen (runtime): pushing a hotfix patch to change default batch_size back to 32 and add kv cache guardrails so memory allocation clamps at 80% of available GPU mem. patch pushed to canary branch.

carol (sre): monitoring key signals: canary 5xx rate, p50/p95 latency, memory OOM events. also tracking customer-facing error traces -> slack thread #prod-errors.

sara (oncall): pinging PD escalation for any open onboarded customers who hit this. can we notify CS for customers with retries?

kevin (releases): rolling restart completed, rollback job rb-991 success. canary config now at v1a2 (batch_size=32).

deploy-bot: rollback job rb-991 completed.

jen (runtime): initial metrics: canary 5xx dropped from 60% -> 2% within 45s of traffic shift and rollback. memory OOM counters back to normal.

incident-bot: Incident summary: SEV2 — canary rollout regression caused KV cache OOMs and 5xxs for canary-routed traffic (~3% of prod). Action taken: traffic pinned to stable, rollback applied, hotfix pushed to canary config.

carol (sre): recommended follow-ups: 1) revert release gating change that bumped batch_size without perf testing for kv-cache scenarios, 2) add automated pre-rollout mem-safety check in rollout pipeline, 3) add alert that fires if kv_cache_mem_alloc > 80% on canary nodes.

sara (oncall): handing off to next oncall for post-incident follow-up. assigning to carol for runbook updates and postmortem.

carol (sre): taking it. i'll draft postmortem and coordinate customer comms with CS.

mike (infra): logs/trace links: https://logs.redwood.internal/streams/PD-INC-48291, perf dash: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/rrr/canary-deploys

kevin (releases): note: temporary mitigation accepted. will revert the batch_size experiment from release branch and add a canary-only perf test.

jen (runtime): copying config patch into repo: `git@repo:redwood/runtime-configs.git` branch hotfix/kv-guard-clamp.

sara (oncall): thanks team. closing pager. if anything regresses reopen thread. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty: Incident PD-INC-48291 acknowledged and resolved — auto-close in 1h unless reopened.

carol (sre): starting postmortem doc now. will include timeline, impact, RCA, and follow-ups. scheduling debrief with releases + runtime tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

sara (oncall): handing pager to carol (post-incident owner).

carol (sre): ack.
